UPWARD +42, itemized, for the mkdir/ENOENT confinement fix integrated from the content worker. WHY: createDeliveryWriteOperations.mkdir validated but NEVER CREATED, while the pinned framework @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@0.83.0 write tool always calls ops.mkdir(dirname(absolutePath)) before writeFile (its default is fsMkdir(dir,{recursive:true})). Empirically reproduced: an approved unit file whose parent directory did not already exist failed with raw ENOENT, making any assignment that adds a new module directory undeliverable -- an unresumable LIVE failure mode. Every pre-existing test pre-created its directories, which is why nothing caught it. WHAT THE +42 BUYS (no line is decorative): ancestorDirectoryChain() enumerates the full approved ancestor chain from the assignment (authority derives from the assignment, never from the filesystem or the argument); createApprovedDirectoryChain() walks it top-down re-asserting EXACT membership at every level (no prefix widening); ensureApprovedDirectoryLevel() creates one level at a time with mkdirSync(dir) and NO recursive option so an unexpected EEXIST fails loudly, then re-lstats the created level and rejects a symlink or non-directory, closing the swap-a-symlink-between-components race; and assertMutationTopology's ancestor walk now tolerates a not-yet-existing directory ONLY after that directory has already passed approved-ancestor membership, so unapproved directories still raise their raw ENOENT. NOT A WIDENING OF FILE AUTHORITY: file writes still gate on policy.allowedAbsolutePaths (exact membership); the widened allowedParentDirectories set governs directory creation only. Verified by orchestrator. EVIDENCE: 8 new regression tests T1-T8 in host/tests/delivery-policy-tools.test.ts, driving the REAL framework tools. T1 deliberately does NOT pre-create the directory and was proven to FAIL before the fix and PASS after (T5/T6/T7 also discriminate), so this does not pin the broken behaviour (BUG-48 RC1 anti-pattern avoided). T2/T3 assert the rejected directory does not exist on disk afterwards, not merely that an error was thrown. T6 pins that enumerated-ancestor authority did not widen back into prefix authority. `recursive` appears nowhere in the file. This ceiling is again flush against the measured actual with zero discretionary headroom.
